items.title: 七年來首次！阿里巴巴擬配售800億港元新股 全部投入AI建設
items.title_en: First Time in Seven Years! Alibaba Plans HK$80 Billion New Share Placement, All Invested in AI Infrastructure
paras: 阿里巴巴(09988-HK) (BABA-US) 宣布港股上市以來首次配售新股，募資800億港元，全部用於人工智慧（AI）基礎設施。
阿里巴巴23日（周日）宣布擬向美國境外非美國人士配售新股，配售總金額800億港元。這也是阿里巴巴2019年港股上市以來首次啟動新股配售。
據《華爾街見聞》報導，本次配售所得款項淨額將100%用於投資全棧AI能力，加強AI基礎設施建設，進一步鞏固阿里在AI領域的全球領先地位。
AI正在成為驅動阿里加速增長的核心引擎，8月20日阿里發布的最新財報顯示，阿里巴巴AI相關產品年化收入（ARR）已突破495億元人民幣（73億美元），預計下季度達到100億美元。
此次配股，本質上是為阿里巴巴已經啟動的大規模資本支出計畫補充彈藥。
首席財務長徐宏在電話會上解釋了這一邏輯：「必須是capex先行，才能獲得後面的業務增長。」無論是AI軟體訂閱、大模型API推理還是GPU租用，商業化都建立在算力中心等基礎設施之上。
阿里巴巴於2025年2月公布了三年3,800億元人民幣的投資計畫。截至2026年6月季度末，阿里巴巴累計已經投入約1,900億元，整體進度符合預期。
在投資回報方面，阿里巴巴執行長吳泳銘表示，AI算力資產目前預計約三年回收成本，隨著AI相關產品毛利率持續提升，回收周期有望進一步縮短至約2.5年，「甚至兩年左右」。
徐宏援引實際運營數據稱，阿里巴巴2018年採購的V100和2020年採購的A100目前仍接近滿載運行，顯示AI算力資產的實際使用壽命明顯長於理論折舊周期——這意味三年回本之後，資產仍可持續貢獻正向自由現金流。
paras_en: Alibaba (09988-HK) (BABA-US) announced its first new‑share placement since its Hong Kong listing, raising HK$80 billion, with the entire proceeds earmarked for artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure.

On Sunday the 23rd, Alibaba said it intends to place new shares to non‑U.S. persons outside the United States, with a total placement amount of HK$80 billion. This is also the first share placement Alibaba has launched since its Hong Kong IPO in 2019.

According to Wall Street Journal’s Chinese edition, the net proceeds from this placement will be 100% used to invest in full‑stack AI capabilities, strengthen AI infrastructure construction, and further cement Alibaba’s global leadership in AI.

AI is becoming the core engine driving Alibaba’s accelerated growth; the latest financial results released on August 20 show that Alibaba’s AI‑related products generated an annualised recurring revenue (ARR) of RMB 49.5 billion (US$7.3 billion), with the figure expected to reach US$10 billion next quarter.
This share issuance essentially serves as ammunition to supplement Alibaba’s already‑launched large‑scale capital‑expenditure programme.

Chief Financial Officer Xu Hong explained the logic in a conference call: “Capex must come first in order to generate subsequent business growth.” Whether it is AI software subscriptions, large‑model API inference, or GPU leasing, commercialization is built on infrastructure such as compute‑power centres.

Alibaba announced a three‑year RMB 380 billion investment plan in February 2025. By the end of the June 2026 quarter, Alibaba had cumulatively invested about RMB 190 billion, with overall progress on track with expectations.

Regarding investment returns, CEO Wu Yongming said AI compute assets are currently projected to recoup costs in roughly three years, and as AI product gross margins continue to improve, the pay‑back period could further shrink to about 2.5 years, “even around two years.”

Xu Hong cited operational data showing that Alibaba’s V100 GPUs purchased in 2018 and A100 GPUs bought in 2020 are still running near full capacity, indicating that the actual service life of AI compute assets far exceeds the theoretical depreciation schedule—meaning that after the three‑year pay‑back, the assets can continue to generate positive free cash flow.

items.title: 輝達AI伺服器明年恐漲逾15%！記憶體成關鍵成本：DRAM飆64%、HBM溢價超300%
items.title_en: Nvidia AI Server Prices May Jump Over 15% Next Year as Memory Becomes Key Cost Driver: DRAM Up 64%, HBM Premium Over 300%
paras: 隨著記憶體晶片成本飆升，輝達(NVDA-US) 部分大型客戶已獲告知，稱搭載輝達人工智慧（AI）晶片的伺服器價格在許多情況下將上漲超過15%。
根據《彭博》報導，知情人士透露，這波漲價預計適用於明年初出貨的系統，包括搭載輝達最新Vera Rubin，以及Grace Blackwell晶片的伺服器。他們表示，實際漲幅將取決於輝達晶片的世代以及記憶體配置。
專家分析指出，《彭博》之所以點名Vera Rubin以及Grace Blackwell是因為兩者共同反映出AI運算對記憶體與儲存資源的需求持續攀升。
Grace Blackwell平台已展現對HBM與DDR5等高效能記憶體的高度需求。隨著相關元件成本增加，輝達先前已提高H200、B200晶片及模組價格，伺服器製造商也同步調整報價，漲幅約達10%至15%。
至於下一代Vera Rubin平台，其記憶體配置預計將更加積極。三星電子(005930KS) 已宣布，旗下企業級SSD PM1763將針對輝達Vera Rubin平台提供支援，其連續讀寫速度較前一代產品提升一倍。
更值得注意的是，記憶體配置正逐漸成為AI伺服器價格的重要變數。即使採用相同世代的AI晶片，不同記憶體容量與配置方案也可能造成顯著的成本差異。
知情人士表示，近期負責為微軟(MSFT-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下Google及甲骨文(ORCL-US) 等大型資料中心營運商代工伺服器的企業，已陸續通知客戶即將調漲價格。輝達代表則未回應評論要求。
在AI基礎建設需求大幅成長之際，連產業中最具主導地位的輝達都無法維持原有價格或自行吸收不斷增加的成本，凸顯記憶體晶片製造商三星電子、SK海力士(000660KS) 及美光科技(MU-US) 的議價能力之強大。
市場數據顯示，2026年第2季DRAM合約價格季增64%，NAND合約價格同期也上漲54%；此外，伺服器DDR5第3季價格仍面臨進一步上漲壓力。
HBM則因為是AI伺服器的重要記憶體配置，價格溢價更為明顯。相關市場資料顯示，HBM產品溢價已超過300%，而單台AI伺服器所使用的DRAM容量約為傳統伺服器的8至10倍。
高盛(GS-US) 更是預估，2026年全年DRAM市場價格可能上漲250%至280%。若這項預測成真，記憶體價格上行將不再只是單一零組件的短期波動，而可能成為AI資料中心建置成本的重要變數。
包括蘋果(AAPL-US) 與高通(QCOM-US) 在內的主要科技企業近期也表示，由於晶片供應短缺，他們被迫提高產品價格。
輝達的AI加速處理器是用於建立及執行AI軟體的電腦核心元件，其效能取決於搭配多少動態隨機存取記憶體（DRAM）。
三星電子、SK海力士及美光這3家公司掌握全球大部分DRAM產能。儘管上述三家公司持續提高產量，但目前仍無法跟上需求快速成長的速度，推動這類標準化元件的價格大幅上漲。
輝達是半導體產業中獲利能力最強的企業之一。由於代工廠台積電(2330-TW) 的晶片供應仍無法滿足失控般的市場需求，輝達得以將單顆晶片售價拉高至數萬美元。
輝達的毛利率，也就是扣除生產成本後的銷售收入占比，目前達到75%。
輝達的AI加速器最初源自售價數百美元的PC遊戲晶片，但隨著需求持續強勁，加上目前市場上仍缺乏足以取代輝達產品的可行方案，其價格也不斷攀升。
根據《Tom's Hardware》本月稍早報導，輝達也已提高面向遊戲市場的PC顯示卡價格。
至於輝達客戶將如何因應此次最新漲價，以及此舉是否會為競爭對手創造切入機會，很可能取決於這些客戶能否自行取得足夠的記憶體供應。
亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、微軟、Google及Meta(META-US) 等主要客戶目前都在積極推動自研晶片計畫，但資料中心建置仍依賴向輝達採購產品。
報導指出，這些企業能否進一步降低對輝達的依賴，也將取決於它們能否從三星電子、SK海力士及美光取得足夠的記憶體供應。
伺服器價格上漲也可能進一步增加業界大規模建置AI資料中心的複雜度。目前許多相關計畫已受到專案延誤、勞動力短缺、資本市場緊縮，以及地方社區反對開發等因素影響。
輝達預計下週公布會計年度第二季財報，預計將成為科技產業及投資人的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: As memory chip costs soar, some of Nvidia's (NVDA-US) large customers have been told that servers equipped with Nvidia AI chips will see price increases of more than 15% in many cases.

According to Bloomberg, insiders said the price hike is expected to apply to systems shipping early next year, including servers using Nvidia's latest Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell chips. They added that the actual increase will depend on the generation of Nvidia chips and the memory configuration.
Analysts noted that Bloomberg singled out Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell because both reflect the growing demand for memory and storage resources in AI computing.

The Grace Blackwell platform has already shown a high demand for high‑performance memory such as HBM and DDR5. As component costs rise, Nvidia has previously raised prices for its H200 and B200 chips and modules, and server makers have adjusted their quotes accordingly, with hikes of roughly 10% to 15%.

For the next‑generation Vera Rubin platform, memory configurations are expected to become even more aggressive. Samsung Electronics (005930KS) has announced that its enterprise SSD PM1763 will support Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform, offering read‑write speeds double those of the previous generation.

It is increasingly noteworthy that memory configuration is becoming a key variable in AI server pricing. Even with the same generation of AI chips, different memory capacities and configurations can lead to significant cost differences.

Sources said that companies currently manufacturing servers for large data‑center operators such as Microsoft (MSFT-US), Alphabet’s Google, and Oracle (ORCL-US) have begun notifying customers of upcoming price increases. Nvidia declined to comment.

Even the industry leader Nvidia cannot maintain its current pricing or absorb the rising costs on its own, highlighting the strong bargaining power of memory chip makers Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix (000660KS) and Micron Technology (MU-US).

Market data shows that DRAM contract prices jumped 64% quarter‑over‑quarter in Q2 2026, while NAND contract prices rose 54% over the same period; server DDR5 prices are also under further upward pressure in Q3.

HBM, a critical memory component for AI servers, is seeing an even sharper premium. Market data indicates HBM products now carry a premium of over 300%, and a single AI server uses roughly 8‑10 times the DRAM capacity of a traditional server.

Goldman Sachs (GS-US) forecasts that DRAM market prices could rise 250%‑280% over the full year 2026. If that materializes, memory price increases will no longer be a short‑term blip for a single component but a major factor in AI data‑center build costs.
Major tech firms including Apple (AAPL-US) and Qualcomm (QCOM-US) have recently said that chip shortages forced them to raise product prices.
Nvidia's AI accelerators are core components for building and running AI software, and their performance depends on how much dynamic random‑access memory (DRAM) they are paired with.

Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron together control the bulk of global DRAM capacity. Although they are expanding output, they still cannot keep pace with the rapid surge in demand, driving steep price hikes for these standardized parts.

Nvidia is one of the most profitable companies in the semiconductor sector. Because TSMC (2330-TW) cannot meet the runaway market demand, Nvidia has been able to push single‑chip prices into the tens of thousands of dollars.
Nvidia's gross margin—sales revenue after production costs—currently sits at 75%.
Nvidia's AI accelerators originated from PC gaming chips that sold for a few hundred dollars, but sustained strong demand and the lack of viable alternatives have continually pushed prices upward.
Earlier this month Tom's Hardware reported that Nvidia has also raised the prices of its PC graphics cards aimed at the gaming market.
How Nvidia's customers will respond to the latest price hike, and whether it creates an opening for rivals, will likely hinge on whether they can secure enough memory supply on their own.
Major customers such as Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft, Google and Meta (META-US) are actively pursuing in‑house chip projects, yet their data‑center builds still rely heavily on Nvidia products.
Reports say that these firms' ability to reduce dependence on Nvidia will also depend on securing sufficient memory from Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron.

Rising server prices could further complicate large‑scale AI data‑center deployments. Many projects are already facing delays due to labor shortages, tighter capital markets, community opposition and other challenges.
Nvidia expects to release its fiscal Q2 earnings next week, which is likely to become a key gauge for the tech sector and investors.

items.title: AI概念股還能漲？Evercore點名「6大」硬體股：2026年下半年將進一步走高
paras: 人工智慧（AI）硬體支出持續強勁，帶動部分科技股今年大幅上漲。Evercore ISI分析師Amit Daryanani認為，部分今年表現最亮眼的科技股，進入2026年下半年後仍有進一步走高的空間。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，Daryanani近日公布下半年「最值得持有的6檔股票」名單，其中包括儲存設備與資料中心網路供應商。他指出，AI硬體支出強勁，已讓相關企業成為今年科技股市場的重要受惠者。
在儲存設備領域，基於硬碟（HDD）需求持續強勁，Daryanani及其團隊看好希捷科技(STX-US) 與威騰電子(WDC-US) 的後市表現。
Daryanani指出，在儲存產品供應持續吃緊的情況下，希捷科技的定價能力有望進一步提升。
此外，隨著希捷科技的Mozaic 3+硬碟平台已通過主要超大規模資料中心業者的認證並進入量產，該公司也擁有「正在擴大規模的兩年技術領先優勢」。
他補充，希捷科技的Mozaic 4+平台目前也正與全球兩大雲端服務供應商推進量產；至於後續的Mozaic 5+平台，預計明年稍晚開始出貨，並接受客戶認證。
至於威騰電子，Daryanani認為，推論型AI與代理式AI（agentic AI）帶動資料產生速度加快，將進一步推升公司的股價。此外，他也看好威騰電子在投入研發後，將自由現金流全數回饋股東的計畫。
截至目前，威騰電子今年股價已上漲約170%，希捷漲幅則達207%。
在資料中心網路供應商方面，Daryanani點名安費諾(APH-US) 、Arista網路(ANET-US) 與思科系統(CSCO-US) 。
他認為，AI需求持續成長，加上安費諾具備擴大併購規模及拓展終端市場的能力，使其今年及未來都有機會跑贏大盤。
Daryanani指出，安費諾在AI相關銅與光纖連接器領域均具領先地位，因此當客戶在銅與光纖元件之間做選擇時，公司有望成為首選的連接方案供應商。
除了AI之外，安費諾也布局國防與工業市場，旗下產品涵蓋互連系統與天線解決方案，因此Daryanani認為，公司仍存在AI以外的成長機會。
至於Arista網路，Daryanani認為，雲端客戶基礎持續多元化將有助公司成長，未來3至4年更可能出現「超額成長」。企業園區網路架構逐步導入，也將成為另一項成長動能。
他指出，網路市場的總潛在市場規模將持續顯著擴大，而Arista正進一步切入「垂直擴展網路」（scale-up networking）市場，隨著這類網路架構的重要性日益提升，公司有望從中受益。
思科則有望在2027會計年度迎來新的成長機會。Daryanani指出，網路設備更新週期可能為公司帶來「第二階段成長」，進一步補強思科目前已獲既有訂單支持、規模達75億美元的AI營收指引。
此外，Daryanani表示，受惠於其從晶片一路延伸至系統設計的完整架構，思科的Silicon One可程式化網路架構也有望在與博通(AVGO-US) 解決方案的競爭中取得可觀市場機會
Daryanani及其團隊同樣看好蘋果(AAPL-US) 的產品與功能發展路線。
他表示，iPhone產品週期仍具吸引力，累積需求、iPhone 18 Pro產品週期，以及預期中的摺疊iPhone推出，都有望支撐iPhone需求與平均售價，尤其是在基礎款iPhone 18延後推出的情況下。
儘管部分投資人對Apple Intelligence及AI版Siri仍抱持懷疑，但Daryanani認為，如果蘋果能成功推出這些功能，可能延長iPhone產品週期、推動換機需求，並開啟新的營收變現機會。
他更將iPhone形容為消費者AI的「收費站」，認為iPhone是使用者與AI互動的主要裝置。隨著AI工具需求持續增加，蘋果未來可能找到更多方式從這項趨勢中獲取營收。
此外，Daryanani指出，蘋果服務業務過去12季持續維持雙位數成長，即使App Store目前面臨壓力，服務業務的成長仍有望成為公司毛利率的正面因素。
在資本回饋方面，他也認為蘋果將約90%的自由現金流透過股利與股票回購回饋股東，並持續將股東利益置於優先地位，同樣是公司的正面因素。

items.title: 伊朗稱美國「已陷入絕望」！嗆新制裁也會失敗  巴基斯坦陸軍參謀長將訪德黑蘭
paras: 伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊（Abbas Araqchi）週日（23日）駁斥美國可能祭出的新一輪制裁，稱相關威脅反映美方已陷入「絕望」，並強調新的制裁措施無法迫使德黑蘭屈服。
根據《路透》報導，美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）預計週一（24日）下午2時（美東時間）舉行記者會，並已揚言將對伊朗實施「歷史上最嚴厲的制裁」。
伊朗經濟目前已承受國際制裁帶來的巨大壓力，基礎設施也多次遭到攻擊。自美國與以色列2月28日對伊朗發動攻擊以來，伊朗境內已有數千人在空襲中喪生。
儘管面臨近6個月的戰事壓力，伊朗仍拒絕讓步。目前伊朗實際上已使荷姆茲海峽的航運近乎停滯，禁止未獲授權的油輪通過這條對全球石油運輸至關重要的水道，也因此推升國際油價。
阿拉格齊將相關情勢形容為「一再重複的劇本」，並在Telegram發布的影片中表示：「他們（美國領導人）從軍事行動……轉而提出同樣的老套計畫，這顯示他們已經絕望。」
他表示，美國若要尋求「建立在正義與尊嚴之上的解決方案」，就必須以尊重的態度與伊朗對話。
阿拉格齊說：「我們從未感到害怕。他們採取的所有行動，無論是封鎖或其他軍事措施，都已經失敗，而他們這次提出的新措施也同樣會失敗。」
美國總統川普則警告，任何向伊朗提供「任何形式生命線」的國家，都可能面臨經濟後果。
貝森特也呼籲中國配合美國行動。根據分析公司Kpler的2025年數據，中國購買的伊朗海運石油占比超過80%。對此，中國則主張透過外交途徑解決衝突。
川普週五表示，美國目前正在觀察戰事後續發展。他認為，伊朗希望達成協議，但「他們還沒有準備好達成一項正確的協議」。
美軍攻擊已嚴重打擊伊朗經濟，也使伊朗海軍與空軍遭到重創。不過，伊朗仍保有一定程度的飛彈與無人機能力，足以干擾油輪運輸，並對區域內對手發動攻擊。
伊朗表示，巴基斯坦陸軍參謀長穆尼爾（Asim Munir）將於週一訪問德黑蘭，討論恢復區域和平與安全的相關努力，但伊朗並未公布更多細節。
巴基斯坦一直在衝突中扮演調解角色。一名巴基斯坦政府消息人士表示，穆尼爾將討論近期局勢，包括美國威脅對伊朗實施新制裁一事。
另一方面，伊朗國會議長卡利巴夫（Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf）週六（22日）表示，德黑蘭已收到鄰近國家「大量訊息」，內容涉及建立新的區域安全安排及經濟合作。
不過，卡利巴夫並未透露具體是哪些國家。他同時指責美國為了以色列利益，使美國在區域內的盟友面臨更大的安全風險，並主張建立獨立且「源自區域自身」的安全秩序，以實現和平與安全。
然而，川普在戰爭初期設定的部分目標至今仍未實現，包括瓦解伊朗核計畫。
由於聯合國核子武器視察人員自2025年起便無法進入伊朗，伊朗核計畫目前的實際狀況仍不明。此外，川普也尚未創造出讓伊朗民眾推翻宗教領袖統治的條件。
儘管伊朗政府仍維持強硬立場，伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚（Masoud Pezeshkian）也呼籲透過外交途徑解決衝突。
根據伊朗通訊社《ISNA》報導，佩澤希齊揚週五表示：「如果能在我們仍然強大且保有尊嚴的今天結束戰爭，讓全世界承認我們的勝利，並強調美國違反所有規範，攻擊了我們的學校、醫院與基礎設施，而且受到全世界憎恨，那麼現在結束戰爭會是更好的選擇。」

items.title: 美國期中選舉對股市是利多？歷史揭示：今年比以往強、標普500選後12個月從未下跌
items.title_en: Is the U.S. Midterm Election Bullish for Stocks? History Shows This Year Is Stronger Than Usual, and the S&P 500 Has Never Declined in the 12 Months After a Midterm
paras: 儘管美股近期出現回落，市場波動也明顯升高，但若放在歷史脈絡下觀察，今年股市表現仍遠優於典型的美國期中選舉年。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，即使經歷8月20日的市場重挫後，標普500指數今年以來以單純股價計算仍上漲11.6%；相比之下，1954年至2022年間平均期中選舉年在相同時間點則下跌1.3%。
分析指出，在典型的期中選舉年，股市通常要到選舉日前夕才會觸底；之後，市場便會在接下來大部分的12個月內持續穩步上升。
換句話說，即使目前股市再下跌11%，其表現仍不會比典型期中選舉年同期更差。
研究人士指出，股市通常在期中選舉前表現疲弱，原因在於市場會對選舉後可能出現的政府政策感到不確定。在這種不確定性下，股市往往下跌；而一旦不確定性消除，市場便會反彈。
值得注意的是，歷史資料顯示，期中選舉究竟由哪個政黨取得優勢，似乎並不是決定股市選後走勢的關鍵。只要選前的不確定性解除，股市往往都會出現上漲。
然而，今年並未出現這種選前疲弱的走勢。事實上，今年股市表現遠強於歷史典型走勢，以至於一些投資人開始擔心，今年的強勁表現是否代表提前「借用」了明年的部分或全部漲幅。如果真是如此，那麼2027年可能會像今年強勁一樣，呈現相對疲弱的表現。
好消息是，數據並不支持投資人的這項擔憂。沒有具統計顯著性的證據顯示，期中選舉後的股市強勢表現取決於期中選舉前是否先出現疲弱。
事實上，數據反而略微支持相反的情況，如果市場在期中選舉前同樣表現強勁，選舉後的漲勢可能更加強勁。
1998年就是一個例子。當年是最近一次在8月中旬前，標普500年初至今漲幅與今年相近的期中選舉年。在當年期中選舉日之後的12個月內，標普500上漲22%。
當然，期中選舉後股市並非每次都會出現如此強勁的漲幅。但自1954年標普500成立以來，該指數在期中選舉後12個月從未出現下跌。
相較之下，在總統任期週期中另外3年的相同12個月期間，標普500約有28%的時間出現下跌。
paras_en: Despite a recent pullback in U.S. equities and noticeably higher market volatility, the year’s market performance still far outshines a typical U.S. midterm election year when viewed in historical context.

According to MarketWatch, even after the sharp market drop on August 20, the S&P 500 has risen 11.6% year‑to‑date on price alone; by contrast, the average midterm election year from 1954 to 2022 fell 1.3% at the same point in the cycle.
Analysis notes that in a typical midterm year the market usually bottoms only on the eve of the election, then climbs steadily for most of the following 12 months.
In other words, even if the market were to fall another 11% now, its performance would still not be worse than the same period in a typical midterm year.

Researchers point out that markets tend to be weak before midterms because investors are uncertain about post‑election government policy; that uncertainty often drags stocks down, and once it clears the market rebounds.
Historical data show that which party wins the midterms does not appear to be the key driver of post‑election market direction—once pre‑election uncertainty is resolved, stocks generally rise.

However, this year has not shown the usual pre‑election weakness. In fact, the market’s strength has been so far above the historical norm that some investors worry the rally may have “borrowed” part or all of next year’s gains, potentially leaving 2027 weaker if that’s the case.
The good news is the data do not support that concern. There is no statistically significant evidence that a strong post‑midterm rally depends on pre‑election weakness.
On the contrary, the data slightly favor the opposite: if the market is already strong before the midterms, the post‑election rally may be even stronger.

1998 provides an example. It was the most recent midterm year before mid‑August when the year‑to‑date S&P 500 gain was similar to this year’s, and the index rose 22% in the 12 months after the election that year.

Of course, the market does not always post such a vigorous gain after a midterm, but since the S&P 500’s inception in 1954, it has never posted a decline in the 12 months following a midterm election.
By contrast, in the same 12‑month window during the other three years of a presidential term, the S&P 500 has fallen about 28% of the time.

items.title: 地緣緊張與獲利出場雙殺多頭！加密貨幣周末集體跳水 17.92萬人爆倉近9億美元
paras: 加密貨幣市場在周末期間上演「高台跳水」，比特幣跌逾2%，以太坊跌5.29%至2383美元，艾達幣重挫14.05%，XRP跌12.21%，XLM跌13.17%，BNB與Solana等主流山寨幣跌幅亦5%。
CoinGlass數據顯示，全球近24小時共有17.92萬張合約部位被強平，爆倉總金額8.82億美元，其中多單爆倉7.53億美元、空單1.29億美元，多頭佔比超八成；最大單筆爆倉出現在幣安ETH/USDC，面值2243萬美元。
跳水前，比特幣連5日走漲，從6.3萬美元衝高至6.93萬美，空頭回補潮一度讓數十億美元空單灰飛煙滅。推升這波反彈的核心催化劑，是美國財長貝森特上周三(19日)宣布將長債單次回購上限從20億美元翻番至至少40億美元，壓低長端收益率、提振風險偏好，加上同日川普會見加密行業高管，市場樂觀情緒透支。
BTC Markets分析師Rachael Lucas指出，國債回購是真驅動，但比特幣高波動屬性未變。預測平台Kalshi上散戶與機構交易員平均押注比特幣2026年底約7.5萬美元，暗示餘下時間偏橫盤換手，而非單邊牛市。
橋水創辦人達里歐上周五(21日)警告，貝森特擴表回購、長債收益率攀升、日本減持美債三者同現，吻合「大債務週期」拐點特徵，美國財政「正處於轉折點」，若不改路徑，三年內左右(上下浮動兩年)將爆發危機。他建議投資人低配債券，將組合10%—15%配黃金，並持「少量」比特幣作分散。
地緣政治緊張因素是周末回檔的另一根稻草。伊朗最高國安委秘書雷札伊周六(22日)表態，任何參與對伊經濟限制的國家均視為敵人，美國在荷姆茲海峽南航道的任何行動都成打擊目標。川普上周三宣布對伊「毀滅性經濟行動」，貝森特隔日稱將實施「史無前例經濟孤立」，伊朗則與阿曼繼續談航道通行。
俄烏戰爭亦升溫普，俄羅斯總統普亭周六稱烏軍40天飛彈無人機襲俄未成轉折，俄軍報復更具破壞性，俄國防部同日通報用遠程高精度武器打掉基輔週邊40餘輛無人機發射卡車及黑海港口儲油設施，烏方則反擊克拉斯諾達爾葉伊斯克港油罐與千公里外煉油廠。
分析師總結指出，加密貨幣此輪跳水=前期獲利盤集中回吐+中東俄烏避險切換+美債財政敘事拉扯，三力疊加。比特幣多頭在7.6萬—6.9萬美元區間槓桿過厚，遇地緣政治問題便觸發連鎖強平；短期看7.5萬美元成新中樞，橫盤換手的機率高於立即反轉。

items.title: Fed不透明的新溝通方式將引發市場「混亂」！高盛警告：無助於經濟運作
paras: 聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）上任後，央行貨幣政策溝通方式正逐步轉變。高盛首席經濟學家兼全球投資研究主管Jan Hatzius警告，隨著聯準會降低前瞻性政策指引，市場對未來利率走向的判斷恐更加混亂，進而放大金融市場波動。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Hatzius表示，聯準會目前採取的溝通模式更加模糊，近期政策會議也減少釋放對未來利率路徑的明確訊號。
華許的理由是，市場過去往往根據聯準會可能採取的利率行動進行定價，反而使市場對通膨本身的看法受到干擾。
然而，Hatzius認為，這套邏輯存在問題。他指出，市場真正反映的是投資人「認為聯準會會怎麼做」，而不是「認為聯準會應該怎麼做」。即使聯準會刻意讓外界更難掌握其政策反應函數，市場仍會持續試圖預測央行下一步行動。
在這種情況下，市場對聯準會下一步政策的猜測可能變得更加不準確，金融市場與金融環境的波動也可能因此升高。
Hatzius認為，這類由聯準會政策不確定性所引發的波動，可能更加隨機，且無助於經濟運作。
Hatzius進一步表示，如果聯準會持續降低正式政策會議中的訊息透明度，卻讓官員透過公開訪談等方式在會議之外釋放非正式政策訊號，反而可能對金融市場造成「負面」影響。
他指出，聯準會官員各自對利率政策發表看法，一直是央行溝通中的老問題。即使是在以溝通含糊著稱的前聯準會主席葛林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）任內，也未能完全避免這種情況。
Hatzius警告，如果聯準會總部的政策溝通減少，但各地聯準銀行總裁仍頻繁對外發表談話，市場收到的各種訊息反而可能變得更加混亂。
在最近一次聯準會利率會議前，投資人對央行利率決策的不確定程度已達多年來高點，美國銀行（Bank of America）分析師形容這種情況「非常不尋常」。
目前市場普遍預期聯準會今年底前仍將進一步升息，但對於升息的速度與幅度仍存在分歧。
根據芝商所（CME）的FedWatch工具，目前投資人定價顯示，聯準會今年底前升息1次的機率為45%，升息2次的機率則為20%。
隨著聯準會進一步改變政策溝通方式，市場未來恐怕不只是關注利率本身，更要面對如何解讀央行訊號所帶來的額外不確定性。

items.title: 為何比特幣、黃金齊漲？美債回購難穩殖利率、美元走弱引爆「貶值交易」
paras: 美國財政部擴大長天期美債回購規模，原本被市場視為穩定債市的重要政策訊號，但實際效果似乎有限，美債殖利率在短暫回落後再度走高，美元則持續走弱。值得注意的是，此舉反而推升比特幣與黃金等資產，使市場重新聚焦「美元貶值交易」。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，美國財政部8月19日宣布，自9月9日起將長天期美債回購操作規模提高一倍，涵蓋10至20年期以及20至30年期美國國債，以「提供更大的流動性支持」。
不過，債市對該消息最初的正面反應，在隔天便迅速反轉。
根據道瓊市場數據，10年期美國公債殖利率週五（21日）持續上升至4.737%。由於10年期美債殖利率也是影響房貸及其他貸款成本的重要基準利率，其走勢受到市場高度關注。
與此同時，30年期美債殖利率也升至5.276%，兩者均回到美國財政部宣布擴大國債回購前一天的水準附近。
值得注意的是，30年期美債殖利率近期才在7月底升至2007年以來最高水準；10年期美債殖利率則在7月31日觸及2025年1月以來最高點。
隨著長天期美債殖利率近期持續走高，投資人對相關走勢的關注也明顯升溫。市場擔憂，長債殖利率上升將推高消費者、企業及美國政府的借貸成本。
本週，美國聯邦政府累計債務已突破40兆美元，而年度利息支出目前也已超過1兆美元。
由於債券殖利率與價格呈反向變動，本週美國固定收益市場整體表現走弱。廣泛追蹤美國投資級債券、其中也包含美國公債的Vanguard 總體債券市場 ETF(BND-US) ，本週小幅下跌0.1%。
BMO美國利率策略主管Ian Lyngen週五在報告中提醒，市場除了重新擔憂「去美元化」、美國信用狀況以及所需的期限溢價可能進一步上升之外，投資人普遍也對美國財政部調整國債回購規模能否真正改變近期美債遭拋售背後的基本面因素，抱持懷疑態度。
值得注意的是，美國財政部此舉推升了比特幣和黃金價格的飆升，使市場聚焦於「美元貶值交易」。

美元貶值交易

 

21Shares宏觀策略主管Stephen Coltman表示，美財政部8月19日公布的美債回購計畫，是推動近期比特幣大漲的「主要催化劑」。
此外，美國總統川普當天在白宮與加密貨幣產業領袖會面，以及市場對《CLARITY Act》加密資產監管法案的樂觀預期，也進一步提振比特幣市場情緒。
Coltman表示，財政部擴大長天期美債回購規模，對市場而言是一項「震撼」，也重新點燃了「美元貶值交易」。
所謂「美元貶值交易」，是指投資人押注美元價值將持續受到侵蝕，因此買進黃金、白銀等貴金屬，以及比特幣等部分加密貨幣。
背後邏輯在於，持續的財政赤字與通膨可能進一步削弱美元購買力，促使投資人轉向黃金等硬資產尋求保障。儘管比特幣是完全數位化的貨幣，但其供給量受到限制，因此也逐漸被視為對抗美元走弱的避險工具。
近期市場其實已出現不少相關訊號。比特幣與黃金及其他大宗商品同步上漲之際，美元卻持續走弱。而貨幣貶值與債券殖利率同步走高，通常被視為投資人信心受到削弱的跡象。
Coltman指出，市場擔心的是，若政府透過政策干預壓低長天期美債殖利率，可能導致金融環境轉向寬鬆，進而推升經濟中的通膨壓力。在這種情況下，美元的吸引力可能下降，投資人也可能擔心，持有長天期美債所獲得的報酬不足以抵銷通膨影響。
Coltman表示，隨著美元走弱，由於比特幣供給有限，部分交易員可能因此將比特幣視為具有吸引力的避險工具。
FactSet數據顯示，衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣表現的ICE美元指數，本週下跌0.8%，且在財政部公布美債回購計畫後明顯走低。
相較之下，比特幣價格則大幅上漲。Coltman指出，財政部公布回購計畫後，比特幣出現異常強勁的升勢，這波上漲很可能促使原本押注比特幣價格下跌的交易員退出空頭部位。隨著空頭平倉，市場買盤增加，進一步推升比特幣價格。
FactSet數據顯示，追蹤比特幣現貨價格的iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF(IBIT-US) 本週大漲22.6%，截至週五的連續3個交易日尤其強勁，每日漲幅均約達6%。

黃金再度受到市場青睞

黃金本週同樣走高，不過漲幅遠不及比特幣。
美國財政部宣布相關措施後，Truist Wealth於8月19日將黃金投資評級上調至「中性」。
Truist Wealth首席投資長Keith Lerner週五表示，黃金受惠於美元隨後走弱，金價也突破200日移動平均線。
Lerner指出，從技術面來看，金價突破這項關鍵指標是正面訊號，代表金價可能進一步上漲。根據FactSet數據，黃金200日移動平均線目前約為每盎司4,518美元。
與此同時，追蹤黃金價格的熱門SPDR黃金ETF(GLD-US) 在8月19日吸引13億美元資金流入，創下1月中旬以來最大的單日資金流入紀錄。
Coltman預期，債券市場接下來可能進一步測試財政部長貝森特是否願意擴大國債回購規模，以穩定長天期美債殖利率。
他指出，目前回購規模其實仍相對有限，而市場對未來可能進一步擴大回購的預期，反而可能引發部分投資人對通膨的擔憂。
Coltman表示，雖然美國財政部並未直接印鈔，但如果財政部透過發行短期國庫券（T-bills）籌措資金，再回購長天期美債，實際效果可能與此類似。
相較之下，政府無法增加黃金與比特幣的供給，這也成為部分投資人將兩者視為對沖美元走弱與通膨風險資產的原因之一。

items.title: 上峰水泥上半年淨利暴增452% 但近9成來自投資收益、水泥本業承壓
items.title_en: Shangfeng Cement Sees Net Profit Surge 452% in H1, Yet Nearly 90% Comes from Investment Gains; Core Cement Business Under Pressure
paras: 2026年08月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國水泥需求萎縮、產能過剩及價格承壓，上峰水泥(000672-CN)2026年上半年帳面獲利雖大幅成長，但主要由投資收益挹注，核心水泥業務仍面臨下行壓力。
上峰水泥上半年歸屬上市公司股東淨利達13.64億元人民幣，年增率452.54%，但非經常性損益高達12.13億元人民幣，占歸屬股東淨利88.93%。若排除非經常性損益，淨利僅1.51億元人民幣，年減率46.54%，凸顯帳面獲利大增並非來自本業改善。
投資收益主要來自上峰水泥透過產業基金投資的盛合晶微上市，相關公允價值變動挹注大額收益，成為上半年淨利大幅成長的主要推力。
反觀水泥本業，上半年營收18.39億元人民幣，年減率19.09%。受到中國水泥需求持續疲弱影響，上半年全國水泥產量年減率8.0%，創17年同期新低；上峰水泥銷量年減率10.54%，平均售價每噸下跌40.09元人民幣，量價同步走弱，持續壓抑建材本業表現。

paras_en: August 23, 2026 (You Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – With Chinese cement demand shrinking, excess capacity and price pressure, Shangfeng Cement (000672-CN) posted a sharply higher reported profit for the first half of 2026, but the gain was mainly driven by investment income, while its core cement operations remain under downward pressure.

Shangfeng Cement’s net profit attributable to shareholders for the first half reached RMB 1.364 billion, up 452.54% year‑on‑year, but non‑recurring gains accounted for RMB 1.213 billion, or 88.93% of that profit. Excluding those items, net profit was only RMB 151 million, a 46.54% decline, highlighting that the headline profit jump did not stem from improvements in the core business.

The investment income mainly came from Shangfeng Cement’s stake in Shenghe Jingwei Co., Ltd. through an industry fund, where a large fair‑value adjustment generated substantial gains and became the primary driver of the first‑half profit surge.

By contrast, the cement segment posted revenue of RMB 1.839 billion in the first half, down 19.09% year‑on‑year. Ongoing weakness in Chinese cement demand led to a national cement production decline of 8.0% year‑on‑year, the lowest level for the same period in 17 years; Shangfeng’s own sales fell 10.54% year‑on‑year, and the average selling price dropped RMB 40.09 per tonne, indicating a simultaneous weakness in volume and price that continues to suppress performance in the building‑materials business.

items.title: 福建水泥上半年由盈轉虧 虧損6921萬元人民幣、量價齊跌拖累營運
items.title_en: Fujian Cement Turns from Profit to Loss in H1, Losing RMB 69.21 million as Volume and Price Both Decline
paras: 2026年08月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 福建水泥(600802-CN)公布2026年上半年財報，受到福建省內水泥需求不如預期，加上區域價格跌幅高於中國全國平均，公司水泥銷售量價齊跌，上半年由盈轉虧，歸屬上市公司股東淨損6,921.13萬元人民幣，相較去年同期淨利2,066.7萬元人民幣明顯惡化。
上半年福建水泥營收6.05億元人民幣，年減率21.45%。公司生產熟料233.63萬噸、水泥302.42萬噸，分別年減率16.30%及8.40%；水泥與商品熟料合計銷量302.89萬噸，年減率8.67%，反映終端需求疲弱對產銷造成壓力。
價格端同樣承壓。2026年上半年福建省內水泥市場需求低於預期，在錯峰生產、環保管控等政策限制下，產業推動「反內卷」協同的難度增加，區域水泥售價跌幅更高於全國平均水準。
在銷量減少與售價下跌雙重影響下，福建水泥營收及獲利同步受到衝擊，並從去年同期獲利轉為虧損，顯示福建區域水泥市場供需與價格壓力仍未明顯緩解。

paras_en: On August 23, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Fujian Cement (600802-CN) released its 2026 first‑half financial results. Weaker-than‑expected cement demand within Fujian Province and regional price drops exceeding the national average led to declines in both cement sales volume and price, turning a profit into a loss for the first half. Net loss attributable to shareholders of the listed company was RMB 69.2113 million, a sharp deterioration from a net profit of RMB 20.667 million in the same period last year.

In the first half, Fujian Cement’s revenue was RMB 605 million, down 21.45% year‑on‑year. The company produced 2.3363 million tonnes of clinker and 3.0242 million tonnes of cement, down 16.30% and 8.40% respectively; total sales of cement and commercial clinker amounted to 3.0289 million tonnes, a year‑on‑year decline of 8.67%, reflecting weak end‑user demand pressuring production and sales.

Pricing was under similar pressure. In the first half of 2026, cement market demand in Fujian Province fell short of expectations. Policy constraints such as staggered production and environmental controls increased the difficulty of promoting “anti‑involution” coordination in the industry, and regional cement prices fell more sharply than the national average.

The combined effect of reduced sales volume and falling prices hit Fujian Cement’s revenue and profitability, turning a profit in the same period last year into a loss, indicating that supply‑demand and price pressures in Fujian’s regional cement market have not eased noticeably.

items.title: 日本有重演1997亞洲金融危機風險？野村：需將「貝森特看跌期權」效果減弱視為前車之鑑
items.title_en: Is Japan Facing a Repeat of the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis? Nomura: Weakened Effect of the “Bessent Put” Should Be Seen as a Warning
paras: 本週，全球金融市場罕見股、債、匯同步承壓的情況，市場質疑美國財政部穩定長債殖利率的政策效果。野村證券警告，日本若仿效美國壓低長債殖利率，壓力恐轉向日元，甚至增加資本外流、重蹈1997年亞洲金融危機風險。
野村證券宏觀策略師松澤中指出，美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）透過擴大美債回購壓低長天期殖利率的做法，所謂的「貝森特看跌期權」（Bessent put）可能正在失去作用。
美財政部的政策介入不僅未能持續穩住債市，反而進一步加大美元的下行壓力。
美國財政部週三宣布，將10年至30年期美債回購規模至少提高一倍，距離上一次公布回購計畫僅約兩週。
然而，市場對政策的正面反應不到一天便消退，長天期美債殖利率短暫回落後迅速反彈，整週大致維持在相近水準。
更值得關注的是，美國目前穩定長債市場的政策操作，可能為日本提供一個警示案例。
松澤中指出，若日本未來透過調整國債供給來壓低長期融資成本，市場壓力未必會消失，反而可能轉嫁至匯率市場，導致日元進一步走弱；若投資人信心同步惡化，甚至可能演變為資本外流，增加類似1997年亞洲金融危機的風險。

美國財政部干預債市　市場反而擔心美元承壓

分析指出，市場對貝森特政策的反應，在美元上甚至比美債更加明顯，使美元明顯走弱。
投資人擔心，如果財政部持續透過調整美債供需來穩定長天期殖利率，市場原本應透過貨幣政策收緊來處理的問題，可能被進一步延後，或使貨幣政策維持相對寬鬆的時間拉長。
貝森特此前曾表示，市場對通膨的擔憂與基本面並不一致，並認為目前的通膨壓力主要來自能源，而且是暫時性因素。
不過，聯準會本週公布的FOMC會議紀要顯示，官員對人工智慧（AI）可能帶來的通膨影響仍存在明顯分歧，目前尚未形成共識。
這也讓市場更加關注，美國政策制定者是否低估AI投資對經濟成長、通膨以及資金需求所產生的影響。

野村警告日本　壓低長債殖利率恐轉化為日元貶值

野村證券進一步提醒，日本可能需要把美國「貝森特看跌期權」效果減弱視為前車之鑑。
松澤中指出，如果日本也試圖透過控制國債供給等方式壓低長期融資成本，市場壓力可能不會消失，而是從債券市場轉移至匯率市場，最終反映為日元貶值。
本週日元仍處於弱勢，日本股市則在主要市場中跌幅最大，下跌3.3%，美國與歐洲股市分別下跌1.9%及1.1%。
債市方面，10年期美債殖利率上升1個基點，歐洲國債殖利率上升5個基點，但日本10年期國債殖利率反而下滑3個基點，呈現明顯背離。
野村認為，如果日本仿效美國，透過減少長天期國債發行等供需措施壓低殖利率，政策副作用可能更多反映在日元匯率。
由於日本央行持有的日本國債比例接近50%，對債市的影響力實際上高於美聯準會，但這也代表市場扭曲可能更容易轉移至匯率市場。
松澤中認為，日元本身已是弱勢貨幣，與美元這類主要儲備貨幣的情況不同。若日本政策出現偏差，日本可能面臨從資本流入國轉變為資本外流來源的風險。他並將當前環境類比於1990年代科技繁榮時期亞洲貨幣危機加劇的背景。
在此情況下，他認為日本至少需要明確表態放棄反通膨的大規模政策信貸，作為穩定市場預期的必要條件。

日本央行升息預期升溫　9月升息機率達8成

另一方面，市場對日本銀行貨幣政策正常化的預期也持續升溫。
目前市場定價顯示，日本央行9月升息的機率已升至約80%，同時反映未來3次升息、政策利率最終升至1.75%的預期；日本最終利率預期，即2年期遠期OIS，也從2.19%升至2.23%。
日本央行近期釋出的政策訊號偏向鷹派，市場甚至開始討論加快升息步調的可能性。
不過，野村證券認為，日本經濟目前仍具有一定韌性，日本央行副行長冰見野良三的談話可能進一步提高市場對9月升息的預期，但不代表央行一定會承諾更快的升息步調。
因此，在市場已高度反映升息預期的情況下，即使9月升息成真，也未必能成為新的市場利多催化劑。
除了貨幣政策之外，市場另一項關注焦點是科技企業債券與政府債券之間日益激烈的資金競爭。
部分大型科技公司的信用違約交換（CDS）利差已升至歷史高位，反映市場開始擔心AI巨額資本支出對企業融資能力造成壓力。
AI投資所需的龐大資金需求正在向信用市場傳導，並與政府發債形成資金競爭。
雖然近期美國財報季進一步驗證AI投資對企業獲利及資本支出的支撐，但如果科技企業債市場持續承壓，企業融資成本與市場風險偏好的變化，也可能反過來影響股市。
因此，科技企業債市場能否穩定，可能成為觀察下週股市能否維持韌性的重要外部指標。
此外，投資人也將關注Jackson Hole全球央行年會，尤其是聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）對資產負債表政策、即量化緊縮（QT）的看法。
如果華許釋放持續縮減資產負債表、避免向金融市場提供過多流動性的訊號，金融市場流動性可能進一步收緊，進而對股市形成壓力。
paras_en: This week, global financial markets experienced the rare simultaneous pressure on equities, bonds, and currencies, prompting doubts about the effectiveness of the U.S. Treasury’s policy to stabilise long‑term bond yields. Nomura Securities warned that if Japan follows the U.S. in trying to push down long‑term yields, the pressure could shift to the yen and even trigger capital outflows, reviving the risk of a repeat of the 1997 Asian financial crisis.

Nomura macro‑strategist Matsuzawa Naka noted that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s strategy of expanding Treasury repurchase operations to lower long‑term yields – the so‑called “Bessent put” – may be losing its potency.
The Treasury’s intervention has not only failed to keep the bond market stable, it has further increased downward pressure on the dollar.
On Wednesday, the Treasury announced it would at least double the size of its 10‑ to 30‑year Treasury repurchase programme, just about two weeks after the previous repurchase plan was disclosed.
However, the market’s positive reaction to the policy faded in less than a day; long‑term U.S. yields briefly fell before quickly rebounding, staying roughly flat for the rest of the week.
More importantly, the policy actions the United States is using to stabilise the long‑bond market could serve as a cautionary example for Japan.

Matsuzawa warned that if Japan later tries to lower long‑term financing costs by adjusting the supply of government bonds, market pressure may not disappear but could shift to the foreign‑exchange market, further weakening the yen; a simultaneous loss of investor confidence could even turn into capital outflows, raising the risk of a crisis similar to that of 1997 in Asia.

U.S. Treasury intervention in the bond market has instead raised concerns that the dollar is under pressure. Analysis shows that the market’s reaction to the Bessent policy is even more pronounced on the dollar than on Treasuries, causing the dollar to weaken noticeably.

Investors fear that if the Treasury continues to stabilise long‑term yields by tweaking U.S. bond supply and demand, problems that should be addressed by tighter monetary policy may be postponed, or monetary policy may remain relatively accommodative for a longer period.
Bessent previously said that market concerns about inflation are not aligned with fundamentals and that current inflation pressures stem mainly from energy costs and are temporary.
However, this week’s FOMC minutes showed that officials remain sharply divided on the inflationary impact of artificial intelligence (AI), and no consensus has been reached yet.
This has heightened market focus on whether U.S. policymakers are underestimating the effect of AI‑driven investment on economic growth, inflation and funding needs.
Nomura warned Japan that it may need to treat the weakening of the U.S. “Bessent put” as a precedent.

Matsuzawa said that if Japan also tries to lower long‑term financing costs by controlling government‑bond supply, market pressure is unlikely to vanish and could move from the bond market to the FX market, ultimately manifesting as yen depreciation.
The yen remained weak this week, and Japan’s equity market posted the biggest decline among major markets, down 3.3%, while U.S. and European stocks fell 1.9% and 1.1% respectively.

In the bond market, the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose 1 basis point and European sovereign yields rose 5 basis points, whereas Japan’s 10‑year government‑bond yield fell 3 basis points, showing a clear divergence.
Nomura believes that if Japan mirrors the U.S. by reducing long‑term government‑bond issuance to push yields down, the policy’s side effects could show up more strongly in the yen’s exchange rate.

Because the Bank of Japan holds almost 50% of Japanese government bonds, its influence on the bond market is actually greater than that of the Fed, but this also means market distortions may more easily spill over into the FX market.

Matsuzawa noted that the yen is already a weak currency, unlike the dollar, which is a primary reserve asset. If Japanese policy deviates, Japan could shift from a net capital‑inflow country to a net capital‑outflow source. He likened the current environment to the backdrop of the Asian currency crises that intensified during the 1990s tech boom.
In this context, he says Japan at least needs to clearly state that it will abandon large‑scale anti‑inflation credit policies as a necessary condition for stabilising market expectations.
Expectations for a Bank of Japan rate hike are heating up, with the probability of a September hike now around 80%.

Current market pricing shows the probability of a September BOJ hike has risen to about 80%, also reflecting expectations of three more hikes and a final policy rate of 1.75%; the two‑year forward OIS rate has moved up from 2.19% to 2.23%.
Recent BOJ signals have tilted hawkish, and the market is even debating the possibility of accelerating the pace of hikes.

Nevertheless, Nomura argues that Japan’s economy still has some resilience; remarks by BOJ Deputy Governor Himemi Yoro‑san could further boost September‑hike expectations, but they do not guarantee the central bank will commit to a faster tightening path.
Thus, even if a September hike materialises, it may not become a fresh market catalyst given that the hike expectation is already largely priced in.
Beyond monetary policy, another market focus is the growing competition for funding between tech‑company bonds and sovereign bonds.
Credit‑default‑swap spreads on some large tech firms have surged to historic highs, reflecting worries that massive AI‑related capital spending could strain corporate financing capacity.
The huge funding needs of AI investment are flowing into credit markets and competing with government‑bond issuance for capital.

Although the latest U.S. earnings season has further validated that AI spending can support corporate profits and capex, persistent pressure on the tech‑bond market could alter corporate financing costs and risk appetite, which in turn may affect equity markets.
Therefore, the stability of the tech‑bond market could become an important external gauge of whether next week’s equity markets can maintain resilience.
Investors will also watch the Jackson Hole global central‑bank meeting, especially Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s views on balance‑sheet policy and quantitative tightening (QT).
If Warsh signals a continued reduction of the balance sheet and a reluctance to flood markets with excess liquidity, financial‑market liquidity could tighten further, adding pressure to equities.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元跌至3個月低點 周線跌幅擴大
items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Falls to 3-Month Low, Weekly Decline Expands
paras: 美元周五(21日)走向7月底以來最差單周表現，受到根深蒂固的財政疑慮打擊。美國財政部意外出手干預，以遏制長天期公債的拋售潮，也引發市場對此類措施可能令美元承壓的擔憂。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報98.80，徘徊在3個月低點附近。本周下跌約0.9%。
外匯市場參與者本周一直關注固定收益市場。在周三之前，美國長天期公債尤其陷入拋售潮，自聯準會(Fed)7月利率決策後便大致持續走弱，原因包括油價上漲引發的通膨疑慮，以及大型企業為資助AI基礎設施支出而大量發行債務所引發的擔憂。30年期公債殖利率周二升至19年高點5.337%，10年期公債殖利率則創下52周新高4.748%。
短天期公債表現則好得多，近期經濟數據降低了市場對聯準會即將升息的預期。
隨後，美國財政部周三表示，將把長天期政府債務的回購規模從20億美元提高至至少40億美元。這項意外干預帶動長天期公債上漲，推動殖利率下滑。然而，這波漲勢大部分在周四和周五回吐，顯示交易員認為此舉只是一項短期解決方案。美國政府債務突破40兆美元的消息引發財政疑慮，也令市場氣氛蒙上陰影。
30年期公債殖利率最新上升3.9個基點至5.276%，10年期公債殖利率則上升4個基點至4.738%。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周四試圖進一步提供支撐，他向CNBC表示，計畫中的回購規模可能高於已宣布的40億美元，並強調政府擁有「龐大工具箱」可以壓低殖利率。
殖利率上升往往會產生類似升息的效果，因為這會推高消費者與企業的借貸成本，而這通常也會推升美元。但美國政府不斷膨脹的債務已引發日益增加的財政疑慮，在此環境下，投資人會尋求將資金從法定貨幣轉向黃金或加密貨幣等硬資產，這種策略被稱為「貨幣貶值交易」。
布魯金斯學會經濟研究員Robin Brooks周四表示，「美國財政部昨天意外宣布增加長天期公債回購，釋放出兩個明確訊號。第一，近期長期殖利率升至20多年來最高水準，已觸及美國一個重要的痛點門檻。這類措施的問題在於，你等於亮出了自己的底牌，而現在事情已經發生了。」
「第二，也是遠為重要的訊號是，政府完全沒有意願面對根本問題，也就是財政政策已經失控，迫切需要控制赤字。相反的，昨天的宣布是一種金融工程，只是在掩蓋美國公債市場日益加劇的壓力。」Brooks補充，「當財政政策失控時，政府顯然可以採取許多措施來壓低殖利率，但這只會對貨幣造成貶值壓力，因為市場無法獲得其所要求的風險溢價。」
市場將焦點轉向下周的傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)經濟政策研討會，以尋找更多利率政策線索。
歐元與英鎊受益 日元終止干預後跌勢
歐洲主要貨幣受惠於美元本周走弱，升至數個月高點，並實現強勁的單周漲幅。
歐元兌美元報1.1679美元，徘徊在5月14日以來最高水準附近，本周已上漲1%。
英鎊兌美元報1.3646美元，為2月13日以來最高，本周上漲約0.8%。
英國政府本周稍早公布的數據顯示，7月整體年度消費者通膨較6月加速。
日元有望終止兌美元跌勢，此前美國與日本當局7月底進行歷史性聯合干預。美元兌日元本周下跌0.2%。
日元周五受到數據支撐，日本7月核心消費者通膨加速至1.8%，同時民間部門採購經理人指數數據強勁，進一步強化市場對日本銀行(BoJ)9月升息的預期。

paras_en: The dollar posted its worst weekly performance since the end of July on Friday (the 21st), hit by deep‑seated fiscal concerns. The U.S. Treasury unexpectedly intervened to curb a sell‑off in long‑term Treasury bonds, sparking worries that such measures could weigh on the dollar.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.1% to 98.80, hovering near a three‑month low. It is down about 0.9% for the week.

Forex market participants have been focused on the bond market this week. Until Wednesday, long‑term U.S. Treasuries were especially under pressure, weakening steadily after the Fed’s July rate decision. Drivers included inflation worries from rising oil prices and concerns that large corporations are issuing massive debt to fund AI infrastructure. The 30‑year Treasury yield rose on Tuesday to a 19‑year high of 5.337%, while the 10‑year yield hit a 52‑week high of 4.748%.
Short‑term Treasury performance was much better, as recent economic data eased expectations of an imminent Fed rate hike.

Later, the Treasury announced on Wednesday that it would increase the size of its long‑term government debt repurchase program from $20 billion to at least $40 billion. The surprise intervention lifted long‑term bonds and pushed yields lower. However, most of the rally was given back on Thursday and Friday, indicating traders view the move as a short‑term fix. The news that U.S. government debt has breached $40 trillion has revived fiscal worries and clouded market sentiment.
The 30‑year yield is now up 3.9 basis points to 5.276%, and the 10‑year yield is up 4 basis points to 4.738%.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent tried to provide further support on Thursday, telling CNBC that the planned repurchase size could exceed the announced $40 billion and emphasizing that the government has a "large toolbox" to push yields down.

Rising yields often have an effect similar to a rate hike because they increase borrowing costs for consumers and businesses, which usually supports the dollar. But the ever‑growing U.S. debt has sparked mounting fiscal concerns, prompting investors to shift funds from fiat currencies into hard assets such as gold or cryptocurrencies – a strategy known as "currency depreciation trade."

Brookings economist Robin Brooks said on Thursday, "The Treasury’s surprise announcement yesterday to increase long‑term Treasury repurchases sends two clear signals. First, long‑term yields have risen to the highest level in over 20 years, hitting a key pain point for the United States. The problem with such a measure is that you’re essentially flashing your hand, and now the damage is done."

"Second, and far more important, is that the government shows no willingness to confront the underlying problem – fiscal policy is out of control and urgently needs deficit restraint. Instead, yesterday’s announcement is a piece of financial engineering that merely masks the growing pressure in the U.S. Treasury market," Brooks added. "When fiscal policy is out of control, the government can take many actions to lower yields, but this only creates downward pressure on the currency because the market cannot obtain the risk premium it demands."
Market attention has shifted to next week’s Jackson Hole economic policy symposium for further clues on rate policy.
Euro and pound gain; yen stalls after intervention ends
Major European currencies benefited from the dollar’s weakness this week, climbing to multi‑month highs and delivering strong weekly gains.
The euro was at $1.1679, near its highest level since May 14, up about 1% for the week.
The pound was at $1.3646, its highest since February 13, up roughly 0.8% for the week.
British government data released earlier this week showed that July’s annual consumer inflation accelerated compared with June.
The yen is expected to halt its decline against the dollar after a historic joint intervention by U.S. and Japanese authorities at the end of July. The dollar/yen slipped 0.2% this week.

On Friday, the yen was supported by data: Japan’s core consumer inflation accelerated to 1.8% in July, and the private‑sector purchasing managers' index came in strong, further bolstering market expectations of a Bank of Japan rate hike in September.
As of about 6:00 a.m. Taiwan time on Saturday (the 22nd), prices were:

Dollar index at 98.8461, down 0.0229%. Euro/USD at 1.1675, down 0.0257%. GBP/USD at 1.3643, up 0.1027%. AUD/USD at 0.7169, up 0.7873%. USD/CAD at 1.3765, down 0.1741%. USD/JPY at 158.9800, down 0.0503%.

items.title: 美國正走日本老路？貝森特救美債恐犧牲美元 專家警告川普政府正在玩火
items.title_en: Is the U.S. Following Japan's Path? Bessonette's Rescue of U.S. Debt May Sacrifice the Dollar, Experts Warn Trump Administration Is Playing with Fire
paras: 美國財政部本周意外承諾擴大長天期公債回購，不僅造成市場劇烈震盪，也引發美國是否正走上日本壓低借貸成本、以匯率疲弱為代價的討論。美元目前跌至三個月低點，並可能寫下本月最差單周表現。
財政部日前宣布，將提前回購的長天期美債規模提高一倍。美債價格最初應聲上漲，但隨後回吐全部漲幅，黃金及其他貴金屬則走高。
布魯金斯學會資深研究員Robin Brooks表示，這項政策是迄今最明確的訊號，顯示美國正朝日本過去的方向前進，可能透過壓低殖利率而削弱美元價值。他警告，川普政府正在「玩火」。
渣打銀行G10外匯策略主管Steven Barrow指出，透過債券回購抑制殖利率，只會增加美元下行壓力，卻無法處理推升借貸成本的根本問題，也就是美國龐大的財政赤字。
不過，美國目前的作法與日本仍有明顯差異。彭博美元指數今年以來僅下跌約1%，而日本前首相安倍晉三推動的「安倍經濟學」，主要依靠大規模寬鬆貨幣政策刺激成長，包括透過量化寬鬆大量創造日圓購買公債、壓低殖利率，並導致日元大幅貶值。
相較之下，美國財政部回購公債不能等同於央行實施貨幣刺激，華府也尚未選擇以美元持續貶值作為壓低殖利率的代價。Barrow指出，美國上月干預匯市以支撐日元時，特別動用歐元而非美元，既避免美元承壓，也讓日本不必出售美債換取美元，從而保護美債殖利率。
他形容，美國希望同時維持低殖利率與強勢美元，卻難以兩者兼得。
外匯交易員正等待聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)月底在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說。若華許釋出鷹派訊號，反駁市場對降息的期待，可能讓美元獲得喘息空間。
Capital.com資深市場分析師Daniela Hathorn表示，華許如何看待持續性通膨、近期長期殖利率走高，以及Fed資產負債表未來的規模與功能，都可能引發美債、美元、黃金及股票重新定價。
反之，若Fed不願以更高利率回應通膨及債市壓力，美元遭稀釋的論述可能進一步升溫。目前選擇權市場對美元的看空程度已達2月以來最高，顯示交易員正為美元繼續下跌布局。Brooks警告，一旦貨幣陷入螺旋式貶值，可能幾乎無法穩定下來。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury this week unexpectedly pledged to expand its long‑term Treasury buyback program, sparking sharp market turbulence and prompting debate over whether America is heading down the same road Japan took—lowering borrowing costs at the expense of a weak currency. The dollar has slipped to a three‑month low and could record its worst weekly performance of the month.

The Treasury announced it will double the size of the early‑repurchase of long‑term Treasuries. Treasury prices initially rose in response, but then gave back the entire gain, while gold and other precious metals moved higher.

Robin Brooks, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, said the policy is the clearest signal yet that the United States is moving in the direction Japan once took, potentially weakening the dollar by pushing yields down. He warned that the Trump administration is "playing with fire."

Steven Barrow, head of G10 FX strategy at Standard Chartered, noted that using bond buybacks to suppress yields only adds downward pressure on the dollar and does not address the underlying problem of rising borrowing costs—the United States’ massive fiscal deficit.

However, the United States’ current approach still differs markedly from Japan’s. The Bloomberg Dollar Index has fallen only about 1% year‑to‑date, whereas former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s "Abenomics" relied on massive monetary easing to spur growth, including large‑scale QE that created yen to buy government bonds, drove yields down and caused a sharp yen depreciation.

In contrast, Treasury buybacks cannot be equated with central‑bank monetary stimulus, and Washington has not chosen a policy of letting the dollar continuously depreciate to lower yields. Barrow pointed out that when the Treasury intervened in the foreign‑exchange market last month to support the yen, it used euros rather than dollars, avoiding pressure on the dollar and sparing Japan from having to sell U.S. Treasuries for dollars, thereby protecting Treasury yields.
He described the U.S. desire to keep yields low while maintaining a strong dollar as a goal that is difficult to achieve simultaneously.

FX traders are awaiting Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting at the end of the month. If Warsh signals a hawkish stance and rebuts market expectations of rate cuts, the dollar could gain some breathing room.

Daniela Hathorn, a senior market analyst at Capital.com, said Warsh’s view on persistent inflation, the recent rise in long‑term yields, and the future size and role of the Fed’s balance sheet could trigger a repricing of Treasuries, the dollar, gold and equities.

Conversely, if the Fed is unwilling to respond to inflation and bond‑market pressure with higher rates, narratives about the dollar being diluted could heat up further. Options markets now show the strongest bearish sentiment on the dollar since February, indicating traders are positioning for further dollar declines. Brooks warned that once a currency enters a spiral of depreciation, it may be almost impossible to stabilize.

items.title: 〈台幣〉資金匯入為實質交投 量縮升值7.7分收31.848元
items.title_en: NTD Inflows Drive Trading; Volume Shrinks, Currency Gains 7.7 Bps to Close at 31.848
paras: 新台幣今(21)日偏強整理，一度見貶值價位，終場收在31.848元，升值7.7分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則快速縮至11.13億美元，以資金匯入為交投主軸。
新台幣今日以31.9元、升值2.5分開出後，最高來到31.848元，午盤左右雖見到貶值至31.93元，全日高低價差僅8.2分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元繼續飆升0.8%，泰銖升逾0.5%，新台幣收升0.24%，星元和日元升0.2%上下，美元指數則跌0.15%，人民幣貶近0.1%。
元大投顧分析，美國財政部宣布擴大回購長天期公債，單次上限從原先 20 億美元，擴大至 40 億美元，甚至更高，但當前市場反應不太領情，同時，考量本次風波是從日債開始，近期 10 年期日債殖利率最高曾逼近 3%，創 1996 年以來紀錄，5 年期日債殖利率更一度衝上歷史新高，因此需一併追蹤日債的最新發展。
統一投顧則分析，美國財政部擴大債券回購但美債殖利率回落曇花一現，加上美國總統川普又對伊朗發動史上最嚴厲的經濟制裁，地緣風險推升國際油價和恐慌指數 VIX 隨之飆升，市場正關注聯準會主席華許下周在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)全球央行年會的演說，藉以尋找利率政策走向的線索。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar was slightly stronger today (21st), briefly touching a weaker level before closing at 31.848, a gain of 7.7 basis points. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms saw transaction value shrink rapidly to $1.113 billion, with capital inflows as the main driver of trading.
The NTD opened at 31.9, up 2.5 basis points, rose to a high of 31.848, and around midday slipped to 31.93. The intraday high‑low range was only 8.2 basis points.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won kept climbing, up 0.8%, the Thai baht rose more than 0.5%, the NTD closed up 0.24%, while the Singapore dollar and Japanese yen each gained about 0.2%. The US dollar index fell 0.15% and the Chinese yuan weakened by nearly 0.1%.

Yuanta Investment Advisory notes that the US Treasury announced an expansion of its long‑term bond repurchase program, raising the single‑transaction ceiling from $20 billion to $40 billion or higher. Market reaction has been muted. The episode began with Japanese bonds, where the 10‑year JGB yield recently peaked near 3%—the highest since 1996—and the 5‑year yield briefly hit a historic high, so developments in Japanese bonds should be monitored as well.

Unified Investment Advisory observes that the Treasury’s larger repo program caused only a fleeting dip in US Treasury yields. Meanwhile, President Trump’s unprecedented sanctions on Iran have lifted geopolitical risk, pushing up global oil prices and the VIX volatility index. Markets are watching Fed Chair Powell’s speech next week at the Jackson Hole global central‑bank meeting for clues on the future path of interest‑rate policy.

items.title: 兩週內長債回購翻倍！貝森特化身「美國首席債券交易員」 成數十年來最積極干預市場的財長
items.title_en: Long-Term Treasury Repo Doubles in Two Weeks! Yellen Becomes "America's Chief Bond Trader" – The Most Aggressive Market-Intervening Treasury Secretary in Decades
paras: 美國財長貝森特正把自身信譽押上交易檯，用一連串超出常規的市場操作壓制美債長端殖利率，被華爾街稱為「數十年來對金融市場干預最積極的財長」。
美國財政部週三(20日)無預警宣布，將10年期至30年期美債的流動性支持回購單次上限從20億美元拉高到「至少40億美元」、整體規模「至少翻倍」，9月9日生效，離上一次公佈回購框架僅隔兩週。
這不是單一動作。美國財政部月初已放出消息稱可能削減長債發行，貝森特上月底更主導近30年來首次直接買日元操作，下令紐約聯準會透過高盛、摩根士丹利拋歐元買日元，規模傳出多達50–100億美元等值，目的在減輕東京被迫拋售美債壓力。
回購消息當日出爐後，10年期美債殖利率收跌約6個基點、30年期跌約9個基點，彭博美元即期指數同步跌至3個月新低，隔日跌幅雖被部分收復，但「財政部親自下場」的訊號已釘進價格裡。
貝森特的動機寫在自己設的KPI上，他曾說「財長是國家最頂尖債券推銷員，國債殖利率就是成績單」，而10年期美債殖利率已衝破川普重返白宮前水位。長端利率居高不下，加上通膨顧慮、聯準會(Fed)走向不明與巨額財政赤字，直接頂住房貸與企業借貸成本，且離11月期中選舉只剩數月，白宮難再坐視。
美國財政部前官員Mark Sobel說：「貝森特和這屆政府對長端上行顯然感到憂慮，這讓人想起他的避險基金背景。」
但貝森特的打法已摩擦到美國財長奉行的「常規可預期」原則。去年11月，貝森特在演講中才背書該原則。
利率策略師Gregory Faranello認為，這確實背離常規可預期，但這就是現實」，避險基金經理Brad Golding更把週三回購比作基金圈「全面掃盤」，同時向多家主要交易商下買單推動波動，「像極了老把戲」。
7月31日那張被拍到的「買日元50–100億」小紙條，以及匯率詢價(rate checks)動作都讓日本前官員意外，顯示干預從匯市燒到債市。
歷史對比更凸顯此次特殊。過去，美國財政部出手多是在金融危機、疫情或新興市場崩潰等突發事件，這回債市下跌卻是「有序漸進」、無單一危機觸發。
Sobel指出，貝森特至少是2000年代初以來最積極干預的財長，政治諮詢公司International Capital Strategies管理合夥人Douglas Rediker亦稱：「貝森特讓所有人都知道，即便沒有慣常危機引信，他的風格仍是積極介入。」
市場服不服，數字會說話。2026財年迄今赤字1.8兆美元、年增5%，社安、醫保、債息與國防支出剛性擴張，共和黨內還在談再減稅。
ABN Amro利率策略師Larissa Fritz及其同事Jaap Teerhuis指出，回購提供近期支撐，但「推升利率的結構性驅動因素仍在，考量融資需求攀升，財部維持大規模回購的能力令人存疑」。
蘇黎世保險首席策略師Guy Miller直言：「只能奏效一段時間，不解決無節制財政就不可持續。」
Onepoint Bfg投資長Peter Boockvar則點出兩面作戰的風險說：「他同時向美債和外匯兩個巨型市場發起挑戰。」
但諷刺的是，干預兩大市場的貝森特曾批評Fed前主席、前財長葉倫2023年壓抑殖利率是出於選舉動機。
白宮經濟顧問米蘭與經濟學家魯比尼2024年聯名論文才把「積極干預式國債發行(ATI)」定調為政治工具，警告「一黨選季開用、後任皆會仿效」。
更值得關注的是，對外關係委員會資深研究員Brad Setser則總結道：「這屆政府不是制定穩定規則然後讓市場自行運作的政府。」
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen is staking her own credibility on the trading floor, using a series of unconventional market operations to suppress long-end U.S. Treasury yields, earning Wall Street the label of "the most aggressive market‑intervening Treasury secretary in decades".

The U.S. Treasury on Wednesday (the 20th) announced without warning that it would raise the single‑transaction ceiling for liquidity‑support repos on 10‑ to 30‑year Treasuries from $20 billion to "at least $40 billion," effectively more than doubling the overall size, with the change taking effect on September 9—just two weeks after the last repo framework was disclosed.

This is not a one‑off move. Earlier this month the Treasury hinted at a possible cut in long‑bond issuance, and at the end of May Yellen led the first direct yen‑buying operation in nearly 30 years, ordering the New York Fed to sell euros and buy yen through Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley in a deal rumored to be worth $5‑10 billion, aimed at easing pressure on Tokyo forced to sell U.S. Treasuries.

On the day the repo news broke, the 10‑year Treasury yield fell about six basis points and the 30‑year fell about nine basis points, while the Bloomberg dollar spot index slipped to a three‑month low; the next day the drop was partially reclaimed, but the signal that the Treasury was “personally stepping in” was already baked into prices.

Yellen’s motivation is written into her own KPI; she has said, "The Treasury secretary is the nation’s top bond salesman, and Treasury yields are the report card," and the 10‑year yield has already breached the level seen before Trump returned to the White House. Persistently high long‑end rates, combined with inflation worries, an uncertain Fed path and massive fiscal deficits, are directly inflating mortgage and corporate borrowing costs, and with only a few months left before the November mid‑term elections, the White House can no longer stand idle.
Former Treasury official Mark Sobel said, "Yellen and this administration are clearly worried about the upward pressure on the long end, which brings to mind her hedge‑fund background."
But Yellen’s approach is rubbing against the Treasury’s long‑standing principle of "regular and predictable" actions, a principle she only endorsed in a speech last November.

Rate strategist Gregory Faranello noted that while this indeed departs from the usual predictability, "that’s the reality," and hedge‑fund manager Brad Golding likened Wednesday’s repo to a "full‑scale sweep" in the fund world, simultaneously placing buy orders with several major dealers to drive volatility, "very much like an old‑hand trick."

The July 31 note that was photographed, showing a "¥50‑100 billion" purchase, along with the rate‑check actions, surprised former Japanese officials, indicating that intervention has moved from the FX market to the bond market.

Historical comparison underscores how unusual this episode is. In the past, Treasury interventions have mostly occurred during crises such as the financial crash, the pandemic, or emerging‑market collapses; this time the bond‑market decline is "orderly and gradual" with no single crisis trigger.

Sobel pointed out that Yellen is at least the most interventionist Treasury secretary since the early 2000s, and International Capital Strategies partner Douglas Rediker added, "Yellen makes it clear that even without a conventional crisis trigger, her style remains aggressively interventionist."

Numbers speak for themselves. To date in FY 2026 the deficit stands at $1.8 trillion, up 5 % year‑over‑year, with Social Security, Medicare, interest on the debt and defense spending expanding rigidly, while Republicans are still debating further tax cuts.

ABN Amro rate strategists Larissa Fritz and colleague Jaap Teerhuis noted that the repo provides short‑term support, but "the structural drivers pushing rates higher remain, and given rising financing needs, the Treasury’s ability to sustain large‑scale repos is doubtful."
Zurich Insurance chief strategist Guy Miller bluntly said, "It can only work for a limited time; without curbing reckless fiscal policy it isn’t sustainable."
Onepoint BFG chief investment officer Peter Boockvar warned of the two‑front risk, saying, "She is simultaneously challenging both the massive Treasury and foreign‑exchange markets."

Ironically, the very Yellen who is intervening in both markets had previously criticized former Fed chair and ex‑Treasury secretary Yellen (Janet) in 2023 for suppressing yields for electoral motives.

A joint 2024 paper by White House economic adviser Milan and economist Rubini labeled "Active Treasury Issuance (ATI)" as a political tool, warning that "once a party uses it in an election season, successors will follow suit."

Even more noteworthy, senior research fellow Brad Setser of the Foreign Relations Committee summed up, "This administration isn’t a government that sets stable rules and lets the market run on its own."

paras: 要點：

創三個月新高

在華府介入債券市場後，歐元升至5月以來最強水準。歐洲確實提供了一些助力，但這波漲勢主要還是源自美元走弱。

歐元沒做太多，就一路走高


週四，eurusd上午升至接近1.17美元，創三個月新高，此前美元遭遇全面拋售。
美元指數跌至98.94附近，英鎊、日圓和瑞士法郎則同步走強。歐洲並沒有突然變得特別強大；真正的催化劑來自美國。
美國財政部將長天期政府公債的預定買回規模從每次20億美元提高一倍至至少40億美元。
債券需求增強，推動30年期殖利率從5.337%降至約5.18%，削弱了美元的一項重要支撐。
殖利率下降會降低美元計價債券對全球投資人的吸引力，進而削弱對美元的需求。


ECB悄悄助攻歐元


利率預期也有利於歐元。交易員目前預期ECB今年還有約45個基點的額外升息空間 — 1個基點等於0.01個百分點；與此同時，市場認為聯準會9月維持美國利率不變的機率約為67%。
路透社調查預期，ECB將在9月進行今年最後一次升息，因能源價格居高不下，使通膨持續高於2%的目標。布蘭特原油價格接近92美元也強化了升息理由，但高油價同時也可能威脅歐元區經濟成長。
歐元區基本面也提供了一些支撐：6月經季節調整後的經常帳盈餘從5月的258億歐元擴大至351億歐元。
經常帳盈餘代表透過貿易與投資收益流入的資金多於流出的資金，為歐元創造了潛在的需求來源。


1.17美元守住下一章的關鍵


眼前的技術面考驗位於1.1680至1.1700美元附近，這個區間同時結合了近期阻力與重要的心理關卡。若能持續突破，下一個目標可能看向1.18；若突破失敗，市場焦點將重新回到1.1600。
聯準會會議紀要讓多頭格局變得更加複雜。紀要顯示官員仍對通膨感到擔憂，其中一些人甚至願意再次升息。如果美國殖利率反彈，美元可能迅速收復失地。
接下來交易員應關注美國殖利率、ECB會議紀要，以及歐美兩地即將公布的通膨數據。
歐元兌美元目前動能偏多，但關鍵在於兩者的差別：真正強勢的歐元能帶來持久的漲勢；暫時走弱的美元，則可能只是一段看起來氣勢驚人的短暫行情。


#TradingView
paras_en: Key points:

The euro broke through $1.17, hitting a three‑month high as bond buy‑backs knock the dollar. After Washington intervened in the bond market, the euro rose to its strongest level since May. Europe did provide some support, but the rally was mainly driven by a weakening dollar. On Thursday, EUR/USD rose in the morning to near $1.17, a three‑month peak, after the dollar suffered a broad‑based sell‑off. The dollar index fell to around 98.94, while the pound, yen and Swiss franc all strengthened. Europe itself did not suddenly become especially strong; the real catalyst came from the United States. The U.S. Treasury doubled the scheduled buy‑back size of long‑term government bonds from $2 billion per operation to at least $4 billion. Higher bond demand pushed the 30‑year yield down from 5.337% to about 5.18%, weakening a key support for the dollar. Lower yields reduce the appeal of dollar‑denominated bonds to global investors, thereby cutting demand for the dollar. The ECB quietly helped the euro. Rate expectations also favor the euro. Traders now see about 45 basis points of additional ECB tightening possible this year—one basis point equals 0.01 percentage point—while the market estimates a roughly 67% chance that the Fed will hold rates steady in September. Reuters’ poll expects the ECB to deliver its final rate hike of the year in September, as high energy prices keep inflation above the 2% target. Brent crude near $92 further bolsters the case for tightening, though high oil prices could also threaten euro‑area growth. Euro‑area fundamentals provide some support: the June current‑account surplus, seasonally adjusted, rose from €25.8 billion in May to €35.1 billion. A current‑account surplus means more money flows in from trade and investment earnings than out, creating a potential source of demand for the euro.

The $1.17 level is the key to the next chapter. Technically, the current test zone lies around $1.1680‑$1.1700, a range that combines recent resistance with an important psychological barrier. If the euro can keep breaking through, the next target may be $1.18; if it fails, focus will shift back to $1.1600. The Fed’s meeting minutes make the bullish picture more complex. The minutes show officials still worried about inflation, with some even willing to raise rates again. If U.S. yields rebound, the dollar could quickly regain lost ground. Going forward, traders should watch U.S. yields, the ECB’s minutes, and upcoming inflation data from both sides of the Atlantic. The euro‑dollar pair currently has a bias toward the upside, but the outcome hinges on the divergence between the two currencies: a truly strong euro can sustain a lasting rally, while a temporarily weak dollar may only produce a short‑lived, seemingly dramatic move.

他補充，「這種『觀感』可能就是30年期美債殖利率在宣布後立即下跌約10個基點的原因，即使財政部並不需要透過大規模回購操作來『大肆宣示』。」
美元也因這項措施而大幅走弱，Wizman表示，這點「較難解釋」。
他表示，「從表面上看，美國財政部的『扭轉操作』是一項現金中性的操作，不會影響美元貨幣供給，也不涉及聯準會(Fed)。不過，我們可以理解為何交易員將增加短天期債券發行的可能性解讀為一項因素，這將持續對聯準會施加政治壓力，使其政策利率維持在低於原本水準。這是解釋美元昨日走弱的合理理由之一。」
美債漲勢很快便宣告短暫，交易員周四重新拋售政府債券，30年期美債殖利率最新上升4.3個基點，至5.237%。一項關鍵因素是美國政府債務總額已突破40兆美元，加劇了市場對財政狀況的擔憂。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周四接受CNBC採訪時表示，市場「沒有看到許多潛在因素」。「我們試圖傳達的是，我們認為這是一個交易量較低的市場領域，目前又處於8月，而且近期有大量企業債券發行影響了市場。」
貝森特表示，「我們一直都會進行回購，而且我們將提高回購規模。」他並補充，回購規模可能高於已宣布的40億美元。

川普周四表示，「沒有人」曾給伊朗「更大的機會」達成協議，但德黑蘭並未把握。這位美國總統承諾將升級對伊朗的經濟戰。

他補充，「這將是一場經濟上的D日(D-DAY，指行動發起當日)。」

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Thursday (the 20th), rebounding from a more‑than‑three‑month low as the rise in US Treasury prices gradually stalled. Higher oil prices also boosted safe‑haven demand.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 98.90. The previous session saw the index plunge 0.8%, its worst single‑day performance since the end of July, briefly falling to 98.77 – the lowest since May 14.
Interest rates and the fixed‑income market continued to dominate forex market attention.

The US Treasury announced on Wednesday that it will increase the size of its long‑term debt repurchase program from $20 billion to at least $40 billion. The announcement pushed US Treasury prices higher, pulling yields down, especially on the long end. The 30‑year yield fell 9.1 basis points from a near‑20‑year high, while the 10‑year yield dropped 5.3 basis points.

Macquarie FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “Traders viewed the Treasury’s announcement yesterday as a ‘proactive’ signal, showing the Treasury is willing to use net‑financing operations more aggressively to prevent long‑term yields from climbing further and/or to free up space for corporate bond issuance.”

He added, “That perception likely explains why the 30‑year yield fell about 10 basis points immediately after the announcement, even though the Treasury does not need a massive repurchase program to ‘make a big statement.’”
The dollar also weakened sharply because of the measure, which Wizman said is “harder to explain.”

He explained, “On the surface, the Treasury’s ‘reversal operation’ is cash‑neutral, does not affect the dollar supply and does not involve the Fed. However, we can understand why traders interpret the possibility of increased short‑term issuance as a factor that will keep political pressure on the Fed to hold policy rates below where they would otherwise be. That is a reasonable explanation for the dollar’s weakness yesterday.”

The rally in US Treasuries was short‑lived; traders sold government bonds again on Thursday, pushing the 30‑year yield up 4.3 basis points to 5.237%. A key factor was that total US government debt has now breached $40 trillion, heightening concerns about fiscal health.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Thursday that the market “has not seen many of the potential factors.” “What we’re trying to convey is that we see this as a low‑volume market segment, it’s August, and there has been a lot of corporate bond issuance recently that has impacted the market,” he said.
Bessent added, “We will continue to conduct repurchases and we will increase the size of the program.” He noted the repurchase amount could exceed the announced $40 billion.
Oil prices keep climbing

Oil continued its weekly rise on Thursday, up more than 7% in total. Brent crude futures were up 2.3% at $93.72 a barrel as the stalemate between the US and Iran over the Strait of Hormuz showed no sign of resolution.
President Trump said on Thursday that “no one” gave Iran a “bigger chance” to reach a deal, but Tehran failed to seize it. The US president pledged to step up the economic war against Iran.

In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote, “I also announce that any country that allows its financial institutions, corporations, airports or government entities to provide any form of support to Iran will face massive economic consequences. Oil smuggling, swap lines, cash transfers, exchanges, ship registrations, shell companies – all of this must stop now.”
He added, “This will be an economic D‑DAY (the day the action is launched).”
The yen weakened on trade‑deficit data

Among other major currencies, the yen fell, with the dollar/yen up 0.6% to 159.15. Since the historic US‑Japan joint intervention at the end of July, the yen’s earlier gains against the dollar have now been roughly halved.

Japanese Ministry of Finance data released on Thursday showed the yen’s weakness was linked to higher energy costs, widening Japan’s July trade deficit to ¥634.58 billion ($3.99 billion), with imports up 27.8% year‑on‑year, driven mainly by higher oil and gas imports.
The euro was flat against the dollar at $1.1674.
The pound rose 0.2% to $1.3627.
